info.title: NFL Pro secured API (pro.nfl.com) — unofficial
info.summary: Reverse-engineered spec for the Next Gen Stats data behind pro.nfl.com's NFL+ Premium paywall.
info.description:
Unofficial OpenAPI description of the **`pro.nfl.com/api/secured/*`** surface -- the Next Gen Stats data that `nextgenstats.nfl.com` stopped serving (see the sibling `nextgenstats/` spec for that dead host's history). NGS moved behind an NFL+ Premium subscription.

**Auth.** A client-credentials token is NOT sufficient -- it mints successfully but is not user-bound, and every `/api/secured/*` call 401s. A user-bound token is obtained only by completing the real `id.nfl.com` login (a 3-step flow: email, a passkey-sign-in *offer* at `/account/sign-in-biometric` with no password field, then password at `/account/sign-in-password`) and confirming the resulting token's `plans` claim carries an ACTIVE `NFL_PLUS_*` entry -- an anonymous token has claims byte-identical to a UID-minted one otherwise. There is no token-mint endpoint modeled here since the login is a browser flow, not a REST operation.

**Gotchas verified by measurement:** an unsupported query param returns HTTP 200 with an EMPTY body (no error envelope) rather than a 400; `week`/`game` are PATH scopes, not query params; responses truncate silently at the page `limit` with the envelope's own `total` as the only truncation signal.

Field-level descriptions are intentionally omitted -- see `catalogs/nfl_pro_secured_returns.md` for why, and the identified `load_nfl_nextgen_stats` cross-walk that could recover some of them.

get.summary: Quarterback passing for the season, incl. Next Gen time-to-throw, aggressiveness and CPOE.

parameters.name: season
parameters.description: Season, as the STARTING year (2024 = the 2024-25 NFL season).

parameters.name: seasonType
parameters.description: Season type code (string): PRE, REG, or POST -- not ESPN's numeric 1/2/3.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size. Responses truncate silently at this many rows with no error and no indication in the body -- the envelope's own `total` is the only signal a caller has that more rows exist. Page with `offset` until the accumulated row count reaches `total`.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Zero-based row offset for pagination.

parameters.name: sortKey
parameters.description: Field name to sort by, e.g. `epa`.

parameters.name: sortValue
parameters.description: Sort direction.

parameters.name: qualifiedPasser
parameters.description: Restrict to players meeting the league qualifying threshold.

200.description: Envelope with the requested params echoed back plus the record collection.

total.description: Total matching rows, independent of what this page returned -- the free truncation detector.

items.description: Column descriptions are deliberately omitted -- no authoritative label source was reachable for these Next Gen Stats field names. See the companion catalogs/nfl_pro_secured_returns.md for the full provenance note. Do not fill these in by inference.

401.description: Token expired, not user-bound, or lacks an active NFL_PLUS_* plan.

403.description: Same as 401 -- both surface the auth failure on this host.

500.description: Frequently a missing required parameter (see `fantasy/game`'s `positionGroup`) -- the body's `statusText` usually names the failed request.
